## Show Item Roulette in Live View (Item Spy)

Shows the item roulette of the player you're spectating in Live View. It "mirrors" their item roulette, so you can see what's happening on their screen, like the roulette spinning, the item they have, and how many items they have left (for example, 3, 2, or 1 Mushroom from a Triple Mushroom).

When switching the player you're spectating, the roulette will immediately update to that player's roulette.

This code can also be used to see if someone is using item-related hacks. A few examples:

* Always Have Item / Item Wheel: The hacked item will be shown as a Mushroom in the slot. If the item they use is different from the one in the slot and it doesn’t disappear, they’re hacking.
* Anti Item Spy: The roulette spins as normal, but you'll see them receive the fake item they're sending. If the item they use is different from the one in the slot, they’re hacking.
* Instant Item Receive: You will see them receive items instantly.
* Roll Item Anywhere: You'll see the roulette start spinning without them collecting an item box (if they're far from item boxes; otherwise it could be lag, since item boxes may be broken on your screen).
